messages:
maya: Quick sync — Q3 model-catalog prioritization. Need decisions before Friday on three things: (1) benchmark acceptance thresholds and sample sizes for onboards, (2) pin TTL tiers (short/standard/locked), and (3) migration incentives for enterprise customers asking for pin exceptions. Slack thread to capture tradeoffs and final asks.

sam: +1. can we summarize current defaults? also are we keeping the 99p latency bench? :thinking_face:

eli: Current defaults I have in doc: sample_size=2000, pass_if >92% accuracy on eval set, latency p99 < 350ms for small seqs. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/cat/onboard-criteria (perm: product+eng).

vivian: Re: pins — customers request "locked" for 6-12mo. That's risky for model freshness. Propose tiers: short=7d, standard=30d, locked=90d with contract opt-in.

maya: That feels reasonable. For bench samples, customers in L10N use cases push for larger n. Could we make sample_size configurable by cohort with a default?

zachary: We already support cohort-specific gates in the pipeline. Ops cost scales linearly with sample_size though. If sample_size > 5k we should run async evaluation and bill bench compute to customer credits.

sam: Proposal from my side: default sample_size=2000, cohort_override up to 5000 (sales signoff), gated async run for >5000. Bench pass criteria: top-line metrics + regression delta < 1.5% vs reference. Latency p99 budget depends on model size.

maya: Sounds good. Can we put these into a compact spec? e.g.
```
bench_defaults:
  sample_size: 2000
  regression_delta_threshold: 1.5
  accuracy_threshold: 92
  latency_p99_max_small_seq: 350ms
```

eli: +1. Also add embed-stability check (cosine drift < 0.02) for embeddings on onboard matrix.

vivian: Pin TTL tiers: I like short/standard/locked but tweak locked to 180d if contract signed + paid. For grace path we allow soft-fallback to pinned sibling variant for 30d during migration.

maya: Important: migration incentives. Sales asks for credits and rollout assistance. We should formalize a "migration voucher": credits for benchmark compute + 1 week SRE runway. Thoughts?

zachary: Voucher makes sense. Add checklist: data-transfer runbook, compatibility shim (if needed), and a customer-facing rollback path.

onboard-bot: New doc created: /docs/onboard-priority-tiers/Q3-spec (editable by product).

sam: Two operational asks: (A) telemetry hooks to surface pin usage and error rates per-customer, (B) a flag to opt a tenant into longer sample_size runs.

eli: We should also define a migration SLO: <= 3% user-visible regressions post-cutover measured over 7d. If breached, auto-fallback to previous pinned model for impacted traffic.

maya: OK action items:
- sam: draft compact spec and add to doc (due Wed)
- eli: add embed-stability and SLO language (due Wed)
- vivian: finalize pin TTLs and gracepath wording + contract clause (due Thu)
- zachary: migration voucher template + ops checklist (due Thu)
- maya: coordinate sales comms and customer signoff template (due Fri)

sam: I'll start a PR with the spec and a sample config JSON for the control plane.

vivian: Quick Q — do we want a hard deprecation window when a model is pinned locked? e.g., we prevent sunset for 180d unless explicit opt-out?

maya: Yes, for locked-tier we commit to not deprecate without 60d notice and joint plan. Add that to the clause.

zachary: Minor: ensure billing tags for async bench jobs so finance can map credits.

eli: +emoji:thumbsup: adding details now.

maya: Thanks all — I'll consolidate into the doc and ping customers on the sample voucher language once PRs land. If anyone needs to escalate, drop me a DM.

onboard-bot: Reminder: weekly onboards sync happens Thu 10:00am.
